description: This PHP source file defines a model class 'CustomerApproval' within the Opencart framework, responsible for managing customer approval records such as retrieval, approval, denial, and deletion operations in the database.

classes.name: CustomerApproval
classes.description: Model class for handling customer approval data and operations within the Opencart framework.

methods.name: deleteApprovalsByCustomerId
methods.description: Deletes approval records for a specific customer based on customer ID.

methods.name: getCustomerApprovals
methods.description: Retrieves a list of customer approval records with optional filtering and pagination.

methods.name: getCustomerApproval
methods.description: Fetches a single customer approval record by its approval ID.

methods.name: getTotalCustomerApprovals
methods.description: Returns the total count of customer approval records matching optional filters.

methods.name: approveCustomer
methods.description: Marks a customer as approved by setting their status to active and removing their approval record.

methods.name: denyCustomer
methods.description: Removes a customer's approval record, effectively denying their approval.

methods.name: approveAffiliate
methods.description: Approves an affiliate customer by updating their status and removing their approval record.

methods.name: denyAffiliate
methods.description: Deny an affiliate customer by deleting their approval record.
